name: K-C Marinette Mill - Marinette WI
type: Tissue / wipers manufacturing mill (Scott Shop Towels, Wypall, Viva paper towels; ~230 employees)

fieldNotes.location: Roster lat/lng (45.099985,-87.630662, APPROXIMATE, moved 3554m) landed in downtown Marinette - wrong. Web research (Wisconsin DNR Green Tier, Waze, Yelp) gave 3120 Riverside Ave; satellite confirmed the K-C tissue/wipers mill complex on the south bank of the Menominee River. Locked center 45.10375,-87.65205.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Guard booth + chain-link sliding gate sits inside the SE yard controlling access to the trailer drop yard / dock area; entrance off Riverside Ave is a wide open paved apron with truck-routing signage ('ALL TRUCKS') - control point is the interior booth.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small tan peaked-roof booth (1-2 vehicle footprint) standing alone in the open yard adjacent to the drop yard, confirmed in Street View (2025-08).
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Large open paved apron between Riverside Ave and the interior guard booth provides ample truck waiting room before the checkpoint.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Open paved yard between the guard booth and the dock faces / drop yard rows allows post-gate queueing.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep open yard from road apron to docks easily holds 3+ trucks queued.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide unmarked paved apron at the entrance - abundant room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated ~28 doors: a long dock face along the south/SW of the main warehouse plus a dock bank on the SE manufacturing building. Roof clutter and shadow make exact count uncertain - banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dedicated gravel drop yard south of the warehouse with two long rows of parked trailers (~52 trailers counted in imagery, capacity ~70); banded 50+.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Clear dedicated trailer-storage lot separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Marinette WI is a small river town (~10k pop); the mill is edge-of-town industrial bounded by river and woods - Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity appears split between the SW warehouse face and the SE manufacturing building, but not clearly two distinct shipping vs receiving clusters - low confidence, called false.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur visible entering the property.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main manufacturing complex (river side), large central warehouse, SE manufacturing/dock building, and the front brick office building - counted as 4 distinct structures; some are interconnected.

citations.claim: WI DNR Green Tier: K-C Marinette Mill became Tier 2 participant 2026-03-10; produces Scott Shop Towels, Wypall, Viva; ~230 workers; operating.
Active K-C careers req tied to the Marinette Mill (Electrical Optimization Engineer).

verification.rationale: Tier-1 DNR status (2026-03) plus active Marinette Mill careers reqs; NOT in the 2018 restructuring closures; no closure/sale/WARN found.
